---
title: "Supplementary Table S2: per-sample mapping and catalogue counts"
format: html
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,hashlib,collections,sys
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569')
out=Path(sys.argv[1]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
co=root/'derived/mapping_recovery_review_2026-09-22-v1/coassembly_mapping_records.json'
records=json.loads(co.read_text());assert len(records)==24
hashes={str(co):hashlib.sha256(co.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
totals={};runs={}
for assay,folder,expected in [('MG','metagenomics',12),('MT','metatranscriptomics',23)]:
 p=root/f'quantification/mags_votu/coverage/{folder}/coverm/output-Read_Count.tsv'
 hashes[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 with p.open(newline='') as f:
  rd=csv.reader(f,delimiter='\t');header=next(rd);assert len(header)-1==expected
  sums=[0]*(len(header)-1)
  for row in rd:
   assert len(row)==len(header)
   for i,v in enumerate(row[1:]):sums[i]+=int(v)
 for h,n in zip(header[1:],sums):
  sample=h.split('__')[0];key=(sample,assay)
  totals[key]=totals.get(key,0)+n;runs[key]=runs.get(key,0)+1
assert len(totals)==24
lines=['# Supplementary Table S2. Per-sample coassembly mapping and catalogue-assigned counts','',
'## A. Coassembly mapping','',
'Mapped alignment records divided by all alignment records in archived SAMtools flagstat reports. Secondary and supplementary alignments are included. These percentages refer to sample coassemblies, not the unified MAG/vOTU catalogue.','',
'| Sample | Assay | Total alignment records | Mapped alignment records | Secondary | Supplementary | Mapped alignment records (%) |',
'|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for r in records:
 assert abs(r['mapped_alignment_percent']-100*r['mapped_alignment_records']/r['total_alignment_records'])<1e-8
 lines.append('| '+' | '.join([r['sample'],r['assay']]+[str(r[k]) for k in ['total_alignment_records','mapped_alignment_records','secondary_records','supplementary_records']]+[f"{r['mapped_alignment_percent']:.2f}"])+' |')
lines+=['','## B. Unified MAG/vOTU catalogue counts','',
'Sum of the reported CoverM Read Count values across all contigs in the staged unified-catalogue count table. MT analytical runs are summed within their physical sample (23 runs across 12 samples); MG has one run per sample. These are unnormalised catalogue-assigned count totals, not percentages or estimates of uniquely mapped primary reads. No unmapped-read row is present in these tables. They are not divided by the coassembly alignment totals in panel A, which refer to a different mapping target.','',
'| Sample | Assay | Sequencing runs | Catalogue-assigned count total |','|---|---|---:|---:|']
for (sample,assay),n in sorted(totals.items()):lines.append(f'| {sample} | {assay} | {runs[(sample,assay)]} | {n} |')
lines+=['','Sample codes: C, control; T, treatment; I, initial; BF, backflush; terminal digit, cleaning cycle. MG, metagenomics; MT, metatranscriptomics. Counts and percentages describe technical mapping yield, not biological replication.','']
(out/'Supplementary_Table_S2.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
(out/'catalogue_count_totals.json').write_text(json.dumps([dict(sample=s,assay=a,sequencing_runs=runs[(s,a)],catalogue_assigned_count_total=n) for (s,a),n in sorted(totals.items())],indent=2))
(out/'CHECKS.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(coassembly_rows=24,catalogue_sample_rows=24,MG_runs=12,MT_runs=23,coassembly_percentages_verified=True,source_sha256=hashes),indent=2))
print(out/'Supplementary_Table_S2.md')
```
